fusions.name: Twin Prong Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a two-pronged link at the first enemy it meets that deals 12 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that, and your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Divergent Lines
fusions.desc: Flicks 2 links out in a wide split to 8 tiles, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Joined Front
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
